name: cover
description: Proves the golden-hour city reads at a glance: traffic runs both ways and staged pedestrians work the pavement, the money, health and armour HUD with its minimap stays crisp against the low sun, and the downtown skyline closes the boulevard behind the stolen coupe. Day lighting at its best.

name: chase
description: Proves the pursuit systems render: three wanted stars lit on a readable HUD, three police cruisers in formation with strobing lights, and the minimap tracking the chase, while traffic and kerbside pedestrians fill the daylight frame on the Avenida Sol.

name: mission
description: Proves the mission loop is legible on foot: objective text and clock on the mission card, the world beacon at the fish market and the minimap diamond, with traffic and pedestrians moving along the harbour quay in late-afternoon light.

name: night
description: Proves the city holds up after dark: lit windows and neon blade signs, streetlight pools, a coupe with its lamps on and four pedestrians walking the lit pavements, and a HUD that stays readable against the night sky.
